text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We ended up spending the entire morning on 
body maintenance... 
I might actually be a little worn out...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Me too~ That maintenance method was way 
too avant-garde... 
Ugh... I feel like my skull still 
aches~...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It threw us off a bit, sure. —But this 
afternoon, we meet at the track. 
This time for sure, we'll get to see 
Ramonu-san's actual training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haaah—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
............ There's no heat in it. 
Huh—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(—So this is the gap in experience... Just 
as I thought, there's so much to learn 
from her running. I need to watch closely 
and absorb everything I can—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
How surprisingly bland. 
Just where... are you looking?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
What was it again... Ah yes, such a noble 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Does it really have to be through racing? 
—Truly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*... *cough*! *pant*, *pant*, 
that's already... thirty laps...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —One more lap.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Kh! What unbelievable stamina...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. 
Ah... yes, this feeling is wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...— 
Just wait for me, my dear...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Servant
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu. 
Your bath is ready.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I see. Perfect timing. 
—If you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
............—To think she was this far 
away.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
..................And she was my idol, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(—She was who I aspired to be. Because she 
was... the very embodiment of the Queen I 
wanted to become.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Mom and Dad met in the racing world—at a 
Japanese Umamusume training academy. 
Having grown up in America, I naturally 
dove right into racing myself.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(And just as naturally—I came to dream of 
the Japanese Tiara. Polishing my skills 
day in and day out so I could go to Japan 
one day was so much fun—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Clashing heart-to-heart in serious 
competition with my rivals! 
The passion... The thrill! I was head over 
heels for those moments.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(I simply loved it, my heart was ablaze—I 
never doubted that this was my path, that 
one day I would become the Queen of 
Japanese racing.)

text_block_list.name: Live Broadcast
text_block_list.text:
"She's strong, so strong, Mejiro Ramonu! 
The first Triple Tiara winner in history! 
Six consecutive victories including the 
prep races! A flawless, undefeated Triple 
Crown Queen is born!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(That Japanese race I watched on the live 
stream. The footage of her claiming the 
first-ever Triple Tiara was unimaginably 
vivid.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Mejiro Ramonu standing beautifully, 
serenely at the pinnacle. 
Her overwhelming presence as a true Queen. 
That was—my ideal.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(I'll be the one to claim the throne next. 
I'll follow in the footsteps of that great 
feat! Just like her—no, surpassing even 
her, I will—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
..................To think the gap was 
this wide. 
More than that... I can't even begin to 
grasp what she's aiming for...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
————Pull yourself together, Daring Heart. 
You don't have time to be whining.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Don't get weak. Don't stop thinking. 
There must be a way to reach where she is. 
...First, I need to find a clue."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go meet up with everyone. 
After all—four heads are better than one!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Haaai! Oh, what's wrong with everyone? 
Did you all spill coffee on freshly washed 
shirts or something? Fufufu!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"It's a waste to just sit around moping. 
Why don't we have a pajama party in my 
room to cheer ourselves up?"
